parsed.post: Discarding the ASPECT_RATIO increase (1.0082 -> 1.0114). It seems increasing width without adjusting LR or regularization is counterproductive. I'm reverting to my best commit bf73602. Next, I will try reducing the learning rate to 0.04 to find a more stable convergence path for this capacity.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate from 0.05 to 0.04 to stabilize training and potentially improve convergence for the DEPTH 6 / ASPECT_RATIO 64 configuration.
